info.title: Zelvyn API
info.description:
The **Zelvyn API** is a stateless calculation and analytics platform for
mathematics, statistics and business metrics.

Every JSON response shares one envelope: successes return
`{ success, data, meta }` and failures return `{ success, error, meta }`,
with a `meta.requestId` correlation id on both. Calculations are never
persisted, and no database is on the calculation path.

## Authentication

**Every calculation endpoint works without an API key.** Requests are served on the anonymous per-IP rate limit by default. An API key is optional: send one in `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or `x-api-key`) to use your account's higher plan rate limit and monthly quota. Keys are scoped to an environment and a plan. To request a higher limit, contact support. A key you supply is always validated: an invalid or revoked key is rejected with `401` rather than silently downgraded to anonymous.

## Conventions

- All request bodies are JSON objects and are strictly validated: unknown
  fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).
- Percentage metrics return **percent points** (`40` means 40%); `roas` is a
  plain ratio (`4` means 4×).
  Percentages are never fractions and never carry a `%` sign.
  - Exact integer results beyond `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` are returned as
    decimal strings (never rounded).
- Every error is a JSON envelope; no HTML error pages are returned for API paths.

tags.name: Statistics
tags.description: Descriptive statistics over numeric datasets (9 operations; up to 10,000 values per request).

tags.name: Math
tags.description: Mathematical foundation: 16 operations (decimal-exact arithmetic, powers/roots/logs, and exact integer combinatorics up to n = 1000).

tags.name: Business Analytics
tags.description: Business metrics: 17 operations across profitability, advertising and customer unit economics. Percentage metrics return percent points; ROAS is a ratio.

post.description: Returns the arithmetic mean of `values` (Σ xᵢ / n). Uses Neumaier compensated summation, so datasets with widely varying magnitudes keep low-order digits. Accepts 1–10,000 finite numbers.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed: wrong types, missing/unknown fields, out-of-range values, or invalid JSON.

issues.message: values must contain at least 1 value

Unauthorized.description: A credential was presented but is invalid, revoked, expired, or malformed. Credential existence is never disclosed.

Forbidden.description: The credential is valid but the account is not permitted to use the API (for example, suspended).

error.message: This account is not permitted to use the API.

NotFound.description: No endpoint or operation matches the requested path.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but does not accept this HTTP method. The `allow` response header lists the supported methods.

allow.description: Comma-separated list of methods supported by the endpoint.

schema.example: POST

error.message: This endpoint only accepts POST requests.

Gone.description: The endpoint has been retired (`ENDPOINT_SUNSET`). The `sunset` header carries the retirement date; remove the integration and use the replacement named in the response.

sunset.description: HTTP-date on which the endpoint stopped being served.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the 1048576-byte (1 MiB) limit.

error.message: Request body exceeds the maximum allowed size of 1048576 bytes.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is well-formed but mathematically or business-undefined for the given input (`DIVISION_BY_ZERO`, `UNDEFINED_RESULT`, or `INVALID_DATASET`).

TooManyRequests.description: The caller exceeded its rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`) or its monthly quota (`QUOTA_EXCEEDED`). The `retry-after` header reports seconds until the rate-limit window resets.

retry-after.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window resets.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Slow down and retry shortly.

InternalServerError.description: An unexpected internal error occurred. Details are logged server-side and never returned.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The control plane (authentication, rate limiting, or quota) is temporarily unavailable. Authenticated requests fail closed; anonymous traffic keeps being served.

RequestIdHeader.name: x-request-id
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional client-supplied correlation id. Must match `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,64}$`. A valid value is echoed in `meta.requestId` and the `x-request-id` response header; an absent or malformed value is replaced by a server-generated UUID v4.

ProfileHeader.name: x-zelvyn-profile
ProfileHeader.description: Selects a response field set. One of `compact`, `default`, `detailed`. `default` is the unprofiled v1 contract (`operation` + `result`) and is always available. `compact` and `detailed` are only honoured where the endpoint offers them, and never beyond the profile an administrator has activated. An unsupported value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR rather than ignored.

schema.example: detailed

bearerAuth.description: Optional. Send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer zlv_<env>_<keyId>_<secret>` to use your plan's higher rate limit and quota. Keyless requests are served on the anonymous rate limit.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Optional alternative to the `Authorization` header: send the raw API key in `x-api-key`. `Authorization` takes precedence if both are present.
